Position Summary

The Lock Desk Analyst II supports day-to-day lock desk operations by processing and validating lock requests and collaborating with internal teams to ensure pricing accuracy. This role is expected to work independently on routine lock desk tasks, support issue resolution, and contribute to process improvement initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

Process and validate new locks, re- locks, change requests, and extensions in accordance with established lock desk policies.
Provide timely, professional pricing and lock-related guidance and support to loan originators, processors, and underwriting, meeting lock desk ticket SLAs
Verify alignment between locked pricing in Optimal Blue/Encompass and investor requirements, ensuring pricing accuracy and escalating discrepancies to the Pricing Desk when identified
Reconcile lock data discrepancies between the LOS and pricing engine
Generate reports on lock pipeline activity, volume, and turnaround times
Maintain documentation to support audit and compliance requirements
Serve as a resource for newer analysts on lock desk procedures and system use
Participate in training sessions, cross-training, and special projects as needed

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, or related field
1–3 years of experience in mortgage lending, lock desk, or loan operations
Familiarity with pricing engines (Optimal Blue, EPPS) and LOS platforms (Encompass preferred)
Proficient in Excel, including pivot tables and basic lookups
Strong analytical and communication skills

Skills

Intermediate Excel proficiency (pivot tables, VLOOKUP, formatting)
Familiarity with LOS and PPE systems
Strong documentation and audit readiness
Ability to multitask and meet daily pricing/locking deadlines
Professional communication and internal customer support
